## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible behavior of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv build`
- [ ] PDF changes were rendered and visually inspected, or this change does not affect PDF output.

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] I considered database, MCP schema, scheduling, and export compatibility.
- [ ] I added or updated regression tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] This change contains no real questions, databases, generated PDFs, secrets, or personal paths.
